packages.section: Part C §7 "P3-bruiser", as amended by Part A §A6.1 (armor that reads: you own game/fx/vfx_director.gd, game/ui/combat_log_overlay.gd and game/audio/audio_director.gd in this phase) and §A6.3 (first-person lens clearance of its strikes landing on the player)
packages.note: The Bruiser: 80 HP, body 2.05 m / r0.45, heavy = true, deep purple. Armor: light hits absorbed (damage lands, its move keeps running, no flinch: armor_light), heavy hits and finishers stagger; the haymaker (breaks_armor) knocks it down and turns the armor off for bruiser_armor_break_s; can_be_grabbed() only while staggered or armor-broken (override in bruiser.gd). A perfect block still staggers it (_parry_staggers true; log it). Attacks: the overhead smash (bruiser_smash, yours, 15, HEAVY, KNOCKDOWN, recoil 0) and the grab + headbutt (P2-grab's moves, kind grab). Armor presentation: an absorbed hit (hit_landed with hit.armor_absorbed) shows a grey spark instead of the burst, a clank from the existing pools (e.g. the block clack pitched down) and ARMOR in the combat log (HitInfo.describe() already appends it). Acts in tests/bot/acts/bruiser_acts.gd (first person): Bruiser shrugs off jabs, Hook staggers the Bruiser, Haymaker breaks the armor, Bruiser smash, Bruiser grab: mash free, Bruiser headbutt, Bruiser winds up behind (corner crop: the larger heavy burst). LOOK at each.

packages.section: Part C §7 "P3-boss", as amended by Part A §A6.2 (the charge's reach_m includes the charge distance; boss_slam HEAVY/THROWN; _parry_staggers false) and §A6.3
packages.note: The graybox boss, placeholder name 'Boss' (Game-boy's answer: name and look wait for the art): 300 HP over two phases, body 2.3 m / r0.5, heavy = true, group "boss", charcoal with orange accents. Armor: light hits absorbed, heavy hits stagger (and get the player out of its grab wind-up), finishers knock it down (the punish window); never grabbable. Attacks: shoulder charge (boss_charge: free_lunge about 4 m over the active frames, stops at walls; reach_m includes the travel so a charge from behind warns at its real range), ground pound (boss_pound: unblockable, a jump clears it), grab slam (P2-grab's boss_grab -> boss_slam, kind grab, victim lifted). At health <= boss_phase2_at x max: emit CombatEvents.boss_phase_changed(self, 2) once, turn faster (boss_phase2_turn_mult) and call in boss_adds_count Street Punks via EncounterSpawner.spawn_adds(&"punk", n, global_position) (group encounter_spawner; with none, spawn the catalog Punk at the nearest navmesh points boss_add_ring_m away). S0's open question is yours: with _parry_staggers() false and blocked_recoil_frames 0 a parry does nothing to the boss; decide (e.g. a short recoil on boss moves so a parry opens a small window, or accept parry-only-blocks) and log it. The boss wave comes every boss_wave_every waves in the crowd room. Acts in tests/bot/acts/boss_acts.gd (first person): Boss charge (in front, and from behind with the warning), Boss pound jumped, Boss grab slam, Boss phase 2 adds, the boss bar bottom centre. LOOK at each; the boss must not fill the view at its posture distance.
